corrected_draft.description_long: The archived White House transcript records President Donald Trump’s August 15, 2020 press briefing remarks about Postmaster General Louis DeJoy and the Postal Service. Trump said, “I don’t know what he’s doing,” while also arguing against additional postal funding he associated with mail-in voting. Those statements document Trump’s public position on the funding debate and election mail. They do not establish that he personally instructed DeJoy to eliminate overtime, remove sorting machines, or reduce delivery trips. Those operational changes and their effects were separate matters discussed in congressional hearings and court proceedings. The held title’s direct-pressure claim therefore goes beyond the transcript. A narrower draft can capture the dated public remarks, while treating the relationship between Trump’s opposition to funding and DeJoy’s operational decisions as an allegation requiring separate evidence rather than as a proven direct order.
